title: Parallel task-node result (WI-388)
description: The schema-forced StructuredOutput each worktree-isolated task agent returns to execute-changeset (AC4) — replaces the fragile grep-for-SVC_WORKER_SUMMARY. The orchestrator merges these mechanically; it never re-parses free text.

files_written.description: the actual paths this task mutated — MUST be a subset of the task's declared file-set the fence partitioned on; a write outside it is a partition violation the merge rejects

checkpoint_sha.description: the worktree commit SHA this task produced (merged back sequentially)

summary.description: ≤~500 tokens: what the task did + any blocker
